An armed gang of unidentified men allegedly went on a stabbing spree at multiple locations in Uttarahalli, injuring at least four people in seemingly unprovoked attacks on Sunday (September 20) night that led to panic.

According to the police, the incidents began around 9 p.m. near Maramma Circle in Hosahalli, where six to seven men travelling on three to four motorcycles and armed with machetes and long knives allegedly attacked a group of four friends standing by the roadside.
Two of the victims, identified as Kiran N. and Kiran H., sustained cut injuries. While one remains under treatment at a hospital, the other was discharged after receiving first aid.

The gang allegedly then moved towards Arehalli gate on Uttarahalli Main Road, where they attacked customers and bystanders near a fish stall. Two men, identified as Raju and Ravi, were injured. Ravi reportedly suffered severe injuries to his ear and hand.
Personnel from the Subramanyapura police station rushed to the spots following the attacks and later recorded statements from the injured victims at hospitals.
Deputy Commissioner of Police (Southwest) Soumyalatha has formed special teams to trace and arrest the accused.
The police have identified four suspects and detained a few others for further investigation to ascertain the motive behind the attack.
